item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #MINPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 17 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #DavaoOccidental, #DavaoDelSur, #DavaoOriental, #DavaoDelNorte, #DavaoDeOro, #DavaoCity, #MisamisOccidental, #MisamisOriental, #Camiguin, #LanaoDelNorte and #Bukidnon within 12 hours.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 29 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 29 FINAL #MINPRSD
Issued at 09:00 PM 16 November 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
